verses.textZh: 奉神旨意作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，和提摩太弟兄，
verses.textZhCnvs: 奉神旨意作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，和提摩太弟兄，
verses.textZhCuv: 奉神旨意，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗和兄弟提摩太
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, chosen by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from our brother Timothy.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
verses.textEn: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

verses.textZh: 写信给在歌罗西的圣徒，和在基督里忠心的弟兄。愿恩惠平安从我们的父神临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 写信给在歌罗西的圣徒，和在基督里忠心的弟兄。愿恩惠平安从我们的父神临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 写信给歌罗西的圣徒，在基督里有忠心的弟兄。愿恩惠、平安从神我们的父归与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: To God’s holy people in Colossae, the faithful brothers and sisters in Christ: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.
verses.textEnEsv: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.
verses.textEnNkjv: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ whoare in Colosse: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: We are writing to God’s holy people in the city of Colosse, who are faithful brothers and sisters in Christ. May God our Father give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: To the saints and faithful brothers and sisters in Christ who are at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.
verses.textEn: To God’s holy people in Colossae, the faithful brothers and sisters in Christ: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

verses.textZh: 我们为你们祈祷的时候，常常感谢神我们主耶稣基督的父，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们为你们祈祷的时候，常常感谢神我们主耶稣基督的父，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们感谢神我们主耶稣基督的父，常常为你们祷告；
verses.textEnNiv: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
verses.textEnEsv: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
verses.textEnNkjv: We give thanks to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.textEnNlt: We always pray for you, and we give thanks to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: We give thanks to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
verses.textEn: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,

verses.textZh: 因为听见你们在基督耶稣里的信心，和对众圣徒的爱心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为听见你们在基督耶稣里的信心，和对众圣徒的爱心。
verses.textZhCuv: 因听见你们在基督耶稣里的信心，并向众圣徒的爱心，
verses.textEnNiv: because we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love you have for all God’s people—
verses.textEnEsv: since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love that you have for all the saints,
verses.textEnNkjv: since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of your love for all the saints;
verses.textEnNlt: For we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all of God’s people,
verses.textEnNasb: since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and the love which you have for all the saints;
verses.textEn: because we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love you have for all God’s people—

verses.textZh: 这都是由于那给你们存在天上的盼望，这盼望是你们从前在福音真理的道上听过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都是由于那给你们存在天上的盼望，这盼望是你们从前在福音真理的道上听过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 是为那给你们存在天上的盼望；这盼望就是你们从前在福音真理的道上所听见的。
verses.textEnNiv: the faith and love that spring from the hope stored up for you in heaven and about which you have already heard in the true message of the gospel
verses.textEnEsv: because of the hope laid up for you in heaven. Of this you have heard before in the word of the truth, the gospel,
verses.textEnNkjv: because of the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel,
verses.textEnNlt: which come from your confident hope of what God has reserved for you in heaven. You have had this expectation ever since you first heard the truth of the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: because of the hope reserved for you in heaven, of which you previously heard in the word of truth, the gospel
verses.textEn: the faith and love that spring from the hope stored up for you in heaven and about which you have already heard in the true message of the gospel

verses.textZh: 这福音传到你们那里，也传到全世界；你们听了福音，因着真理确实认识了神的恩典之后，这福音就在你们中间不断地结果和增长，在全世界也是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这福音传到你们那里，也传到全世界；你们听了福音，因着真理确实认识了神的恩典之后，这福音就在你们中间不断地结果和增长，在全世界也是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这福音传到你们那里，也传到普天之下，并且结果，增长，如同在你们中间，自从你们听见福音，真知道神恩惠的日子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: that has come to you. In the same way, the gospel is bearing fruit and growing throughout the whole world—just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood God’s grace.
verses.textEnEsv: which has come to you, as indeed in the whole world it is bearing fruit and increasing—as it also does among you, since the day you heard it and understood the grace of God in truth,
verses.textEnNkjv: which has come to you, as ithas also in all the world, and is bringing forth fruit, as itis also among you since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;
verses.textEnNlt: This same Good News that came to you is going out all over the world. It is bearing fruit everywhere by changing lives, just as it changed your lives from the day you first heard and understood the truth about God’s wonderful grace.
verses.textEnNasb: which has come to you, just as in all the world also it is bearing fruit and increasing, even as it has been doing in you also since the day you heard it and understood the grace of God in truth;
verses.textEn: that has come to you. In the same way, the gospel is bearing fruit and growing throughout the whole world—just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood God’s grace.

verses.textZh: 这福音也就是你们从我们亲爱的、一同作仆人 的以巴弗那里学到的。他为你们作了基督忠心的仆役，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这福音也就是你们从我们亲爱的、一同作仆人 的以巴弗那里学到的。他为你们作了基督忠心的仆役，
verses.textZhCuv: 正如你们从我们所亲爱、一同作仆人的以巴弗所学的。他为我们 作了基督忠心的执事，
verses.textEnNiv: You learned it from Epaphras, our dear fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
verses.textEnEsv: just as you learned it from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant. He is a faithful minister of Christ on your behalf
verses.textEnNkjv: as you also learned from Epaphras, our dear fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on your behalf,
verses.textEnNlt: You learned about the Good News from Epaphras, our beloved co-worker. He is Christ’s faithful servant, and he is helping us on your behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: just as you learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow bond-servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on our behalf,
verses.textEn: You learned it from Epaphras, our dear fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,

verses.textZh: 也把你们在圣灵里的爱心告诉了我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也把你们在圣灵里的爱心告诉了我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 也把你们因圣灵所存的爱心告诉了我们。
verses.textEnNiv: and who also told us of your love in the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: and has made known to us your love in the Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: He has told us about the love for others that the Holy Spirit has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: and he also informed us of your love in the Spirit.
verses.textEn: and who also told us of your love in the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 因此，我们从听见的那天起，就不停地为你们祷告祈求，愿你们借着一切属灵的智慧和悟性，可以充分明白神的旨意，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们从听见的那天起，就不停地为你们祷告祈求，愿你们借着一切属灵的智慧和悟性，可以充分明白神的旨意，
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我们自从听见的日子，也就为你们不住地祷告祈求，愿你们在一切属灵的智慧悟性上，满心知道神的旨意；
verses.textEnNiv: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you. We continually ask God to fill you with the knowledge of his will through all the wisdom and understanding that the Spirit gives,
verses.textEnEsv: And so, from the day we heard, we have not ceased to pray for you, asking that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to ask that you may be filled with the knowledge of His will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
verses.textEnNlt: So we have not stopped praying for you since we first heard about you. We ask God to give you complete knowledge of his will and to give you spiritual wisdom and understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason we also, since the day we heard about it, have not ceased praying for you and asking that you may be filled with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
verses.textEn: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you. We continually ask God to fill you with the knowledge of his will through all the wisdom and understanding that the Spirit gives,

verses.textZh: 使你们行事为人对得起主，凡事蒙他喜悦；在一切善事上多结果子，更加认识神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 使你们行事为人对得起主，凡事蒙他喜悦；在一切善事上多结果子，更加认识神；
verses.textZhCuv: 好叫你们行事为人对得起主，凡事蒙他喜悦，在一切善事上结果子，渐渐地多知道神；
verses.textEnNiv: so that you may live a life worthy of the Lord and please him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
verses.textEnEsv: so as to walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing to him: bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may walk worthy of the Lord, fully pleasing Him, being fruitful in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.textEnNlt: Then the way you live will always honor and please the Lord, and your lives will produce every kind of good fruit. All the while, you will grow as you learn to know God better and better.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you will walk in a manner worthy of the Lord, to please Him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God;
verses.textEn: so that you may live a life worthy of the Lord and please him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

verses.textZh: 依照他荣耀的大能得着一切能力，带着喜乐的心，凡事忍耐宽容；
verses.textZhCnvs: 依照他荣耀的大能得着一切能力，带着喜乐的心，凡事忍耐宽容；
verses.textZhCuv: 照他荣耀的权能，得以在各样的力上加力，好叫你们凡事欢欢喜喜地忍耐宽容；
verses.textEnNiv: being strengthened with all power according to his glorious might so that you may have great endurance and patience,
verses.textEnEsv: being strengthened with all power, according to his glorious might, for all endurance and patience with joy;
verses.textEnNkjv: strengthened with all might, according to His glorious power, for all patience and longsuffering with joy;
verses.textEnNlt: We also pray that you will be strengthened with all his glorious power so you will have all the endurance and patience you need. May you be filled with joy,
verses.textEnNasb: strengthened with all power, according to His glorious might, for the attaining of all perseverance and patience; joyously
verses.textEn: being strengthened with all power according to his glorious might so that you may have great endurance and patience,

verses.textZh: 并且感谢父，他使你们有资格分享圣徒在光明中的基业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且感谢父，他使你们有资格分享圣徒在光明中的基业。
verses.textZhCuv: 又感谢父，叫我们能与众圣徒在光明中同得基业。
verses.textEnNiv: and giving joyful thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of his holy people in the kingdom of light.
verses.textEnEsv: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in light.
verses.textEnNkjv: giving thanks to the Father who has qualified us to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in the light.
verses.textEnNlt: always thanking the Father. He has enabled you to share in the inheritance that belongs to his people, who live in the light.
verses.textEnNasb: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in light.
verses.textEn: and giving joyful thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of his holy people in the kingdom of light.

verses.textZh: 他救我们脱离了黑暗的权势，把我们迁入他爱子的国里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救我们脱离了黑暗的权势，把我们迁入他爱子的国里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他救了我们脱离黑暗的权势，把我们迁到他爱子的国里；
verses.textEnNiv: For he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves,
verses.textEnEsv: He has delivered us from the domain of darkness and transferred us to the kingdom of his beloved Son,
verses.textEnNkjv: He has delivered us from the power of darkness and conveyed us into the kingdom of the Son of His love,
verses.textEnNlt: For he has rescued us from the kingdom of darkness and transferred us into the Kingdom of his dear Son,
verses.textEnNasb: For He rescued us from the domain of darkness, and transferred us to the kingdom of His beloved Son,
verses.textEn: For he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves,

verses.textZh: 我们在爱子里蒙了救赎，罪得赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在爱子里蒙了救赎，罪得赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在爱子里得蒙救赎，罪过得以赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnEsv: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: in whom we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEnNlt: who purchased our freedom and forgave our sins.
verses.textEnNasb: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
verses.textEn: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

verses.textZh: 这爱子是那看不见的神的形象，是首先的，在一切被造的之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这爱子是那看不见的神的形象，是首先的，在一切被造的之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱子是那不能看见之神的像，是首生的，在一切被造的以先。
verses.textEnNiv: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
verses.textEnEsv: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
verses.textEnNkjv: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
verses.textEnNlt: Christ is the visible image of the invisible God. He existed before anything was created and is supreme over all creation,
verses.textEnNasb: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation:
verses.textEn: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

verses.textZh: 因为天上地上的万有：看得见的和看不见的，无论是坐王位的，或是作主的，或是执政的，或是掌权的，都是本着他造的；万有都是借着他，又是为着他而造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为天上地上的万有：看得见的和看不见的，无论是坐王位的，或是作主的，或是执政的，或是掌权的，都是本着他造的；万有都是借着他，又是为着他而造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为万有都是靠他造的，无论是天上的，地上的；能看见的，不能看见的；或是有位的，主治的，执政的，掌权的；一概都是藉着他造的，又是为他造的。
verses.textEnNiv: For in him all things were created: things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through him and for him.
verses.textEnEsv: For by him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities—all things were created through him and for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For by Him all things were created that are in heaven and that are on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things were created through Him and for Him.
verses.textEnNlt: for through him God created everything in the heavenly realms and on earth. He made the things we can see and the things we can’t see— such as thrones, kingdoms, rulers, and authorities in the unseen world. Everything was created through him and for him.
verses.textEnNasb: for by Him all things were created, both in the heavens and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones, or dominions, or rulers, or authorities—all things have been created through Him and for Him.
verses.textEn: For in him all things were created: things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through him and for him.

verses.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也一同靠着他而存在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在万有之先；万有也一同靠着他而存在。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。
verses.textEnNiv: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verses.textEnEsv: And he is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He is before all things, and in Him all things consist.
verses.textEnNlt: He existed before anything else, and he holds all creation together.
verses.textEnNasb: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
verses.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.

verses.textZh: 他是身体的头，这身体就是教会。他是元始，是死人中首先复生的，好让他在凡事上居首位；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是身体的头，这身体就是教会。他是元始，是死人中首先复生的，好让他在凡事上居首位；
verses.textZhCuv: 他也是教会全体之首。他是元始，是从死里首先复生的，使他可以在凡事上居首位。
verses.textEnNiv: And he is the head of the body, the church; he is the beginning and the firstborn from among the dead, so that in everything he might have the supremacy.
verses.textEnEsv: And he is the head of the body, the church. He is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in everything he might be preeminent.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He is the head of the body, the church, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things He may have the preeminence.
verses.textEnNlt: Christ is also the head of the church, which is his body. He is the beginning, supreme over all who rise from the dead. So he is first in everything.
verses.textEnNasb: He is also the head of the body, the church; and He is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, so that He Himself will come to have first place in everything.
verses.textEn: And he is the head of the body, the church; he is the beginning and the firstborn from among the dead, so that in everything he might have the supremacy.

verses.textZh: 因为神乐意使所有的丰盛都住在爱子里面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神乐意使所有的丰盛都住在爱子里面，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为父喜欢叫一切的丰盛在他里面居住。
verses.textEnNiv: For God was pleased to have all his fullness dwell in him,
verses.textEnEsv: For in him all the fullness of God was pleased to dwell,
verses.textEnNkjv: For it pleased theFatherthat in Him all the fullness should dwell,
verses.textEnNlt: For God in all his fullness was pleased to live in Christ,
verses.textEnNasb: For it was the Father’s good pleasure for all the fullness to dwell in Him,
verses.textEn: For God was pleased to have all his fullness dwell in him,

verses.textZh: 并且借着他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平，使万有，无论是地上天上的，都借着他与神和好了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且借着他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平，使万有，无论是地上天上的，都借着他与神和好了。
verses.textZhCuv: 既然藉着他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平，便藉着他叫万有－无论是地上的、天上的－都与自己和好了。
verses.textEnNiv: and through him to reconcile to himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through his blood, shed on the cross.
verses.textEnEsv: and through him to reconcile to himself all things, whether on earth or in heaven, making peace by the blood of his cross.
verses.textEnNkjv: and by Him to reconcile all things to Himself, by Him, whether things on earth or things in heaven, having made peace through the blood of His cross.
verses.textEnNlt: and through him God reconciled everything to himself. He made peace with everything in heaven and on earth by means of Christ’s blood on the cross.
verses.textEnNasb: and through Him to reconcile all things to Himself, whether things on earth or things in heaven, having made peace through the blood of His cross.
verses.textEn: and through him to reconcile to himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through his blood, shed on the cross.

verses.textZh: 虽然你们从前也是和神隔绝，心思上与他为敌，行为邪恶，
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然你们从前也是和神隔绝，心思上与他为敌，行为邪恶，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从前与神隔绝，因着恶行，心里与他为敌。
verses.textEnNiv: Once you were alienated from God and were enemies in your minds because of your evil behavior.
verses.textEnEsv: And you, who once were alienated and hostile in mind, doing evil deeds,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, who once were alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now He has reconciled
verses.textEnNlt: This includes you who were once far away from God. You were his enemies, separated from him by your evil thoughts and actions.
verses.textEnNasb: And although you were previously alienated and hostile in attitude, engaged in evil deeds,
verses.textEn: Once you were alienated from God and were enemies in your minds because of your evil behavior.

verses.textZh: 但现今神在爱子的肉身上，借着他的死，使你们与神和好了，为了要把你们这些圣洁、无瑕疵、无可指摘的人，呈献在他面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现今神在爱子的肉身上，借着他的死，使你们与神和好了，为了要把你们这些圣洁、无瑕疵、无可指摘的人，呈献在他面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今他藉着基督的肉身受死，叫你们与自己和好，都成了圣洁，没有瑕疵，无可责备，把你们引到自己面前。
verses.textEnNiv: But now he has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy in his sight, without blemish and free from accusation—
verses.textEnEsv: he has now reconciled in his body of flesh by his death, in order to present you holy and blameless and above reproach before him,
verses.textEnNkjv: in the body of His flesh through death, to present you holy, and blameless, and above reproach in His sight—
verses.textEnNlt: Yet now he has reconciled you to himself through the death of Christ in his physical body. As a result, he has brought you into his own presence, and you are holy and blameless as you stand before him without a single fault.
verses.textEnNasb: yet He has now reconciled you in His body of flesh through death, in order to present you before Him holy and blameless and beyond reproach—
verses.textEn: But now he has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy in his sight, without blemish and free from accusation—

verses.textZh: 只是你们要常存信心，根基稳固，不受动摇偏离福音的盼望。这福音你们听过了，也传给了天下万民；我保罗也作了这福音的仆役。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是你们要常存信心，根基稳固，不受动摇偏离福音的盼望。这福音你们听过了，也传给了天下万民；我保罗也作了这福音的仆役。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要你们在所信的道上恒心，根基稳固，坚定不移，不至被引动失去 福音的盼望。这福音就是你们所听过的，也是传与普天下万人听的 ，我－保罗也作了这福音的执事。
verses.textEnNiv: if you continue in your faith, established and firm, and do not move from the hope held out in the gospel. This is the gospel that you heard and that has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
verses.textEnEsv: if indeed you continue in the faith, stable and steadfast, not shifting from the hope of the gospel that you heard, which has been proclaimed in all creation under heaven, and of which I, Paul, became a minister.
verses.textEnNkjv: if indeed you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and are not moved away from the hope of the gospel which you heard, which was preached to every creature under heaven, of which I, Paul, became a minister.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must continue to believe this truth and stand firmly in it. Don’t drift away from the assurance you received when you heard the Good News. The Good News has been preached all over the world, and I, Paul, have been appointed as God’s servant to proclaim it.
verses.textEnNasb: if indeed you continue in the faith firmly established and steadfast, and not shifting from the hope of the gospel that you have heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, and of which I, Paul, was made a minister.
verses.textEn: if you continue in your faith, established and firm, and do not move from the hope held out in the gospel. This is the gospel that you heard and that has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.

verses.textZh: 现在我为你们受苦，我觉得喜乐；为了基督的身体，就是为了教会，我要在自己的肉身上，补满基督苦难的不足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我为你们受苦，我觉得喜乐；为了基督的身体，就是为了教会，我要在自己的肉身上，补满基督苦难的不足。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我为你们受苦，倒觉欢乐；并且为基督的身体，就是为教会，要在我肉身上补满基督患难的缺欠。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I rejoice in what I am suffering for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is still lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions, for the sake of his body, which is the church.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and in my flesh I am filling up what is lacking in Christ’s afflictions for the sake of his body, that is, the church,
verses.textEnNkjv: I now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up in my flesh what is lacking in the afflictions of Christ, for the sake of His body, which is the church,
verses.textEnNlt: I am glad when I suffer for you in my body, for I am participating in the sufferings of Christ that continue for his body, the church.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and in my flesh I am supplementing what is lacking in Christ’s afflictions in behalf of His body, which is the church.
verses.textEn: Now I rejoice in what I am suffering for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is still lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions, for the sake of his body, which is the church.

verses.textZh: 神愿意使他们知道这奥秘在外族人中有多么荣耀的丰盛，这奥秘就是基督在你们里面成了荣耀的盼望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神愿意使他们知道这奥秘在外族人中有多么荣耀的丰盛，这奥秘就是基督在你们里面成了荣耀的盼望。
verses.textZhCuv: 我照神为你们所赐我的职分作了教会的执事，要把神的道理传得全备，
verses.textEnNiv: I have become its servant by the commission God gave me to present to you the word of God in its fullness—
verses.textEnEsv: of which I became a minister according to the stewardship from God that was given to me for you, to make the word of God fully known,
verses.textEnNkjv: of which I became a minister according to the stewardship from God which was given to me for you, to fulfill the word of God,
verses.textEnNlt: God has given me the responsibility of serving his church by proclaiming his entire message to you.
verses.textEnNasb: I was made a minister of this church according to the commission from God granted to me for your benefit, so that I might fully carry out the preaching of the word of God,
verses.textEn: I have become its servant by the commission God gave me to present to you the word of God in its fullness—

verses.textZh: 我们传扬他，是用各样的智慧，劝戒各人，教导各人，为了要使各人在基督里得到完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们传扬他，是用各样的智慧，劝戒各人，教导各人，为了要使各人在基督里得到完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 这道理就是历世历代所隐藏的奥秘；但如今向他的圣徒显明了。
verses.textEnNiv: the mystery that has been kept hidden for ages and generations, but is now disclosed to the Lord’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: the mystery hidden for ages and generations but now revealed to his saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: the mystery which has been hidden from ages and from generations, but now has been revealed to His saints.
verses.textEnNlt: This message was kept secret for centuries and generations past, but now it has been revealed to God’s people.
verses.textEnNasb: that is, the mystery which had been hidden from the past ages and generations, but now has been revealed to His saints,
verses.textEn: the mystery that has been kept hidden for ages and generations, but is now disclosed to the Lord’s people.

verses.textZh: 我也为了这事劳苦，按着他用大能在我心中运行的动力，竭力奋斗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也为了这事劳苦，按着他用大能在我心中运行的动力，竭力奋斗。
verses.textZhCuv: 神愿意叫他们知道，这奥秘在外邦人中有何等丰盛的荣耀，就是基督在你们心里成了有荣耀的盼望。
verses.textEnNiv: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
verses.textEnEsv: To them God chose to make known how great among the Gentiles are the riches of the glory of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: To them God willed to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles: which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
verses.textEnNlt: For God wanted them to know that the riches and glory of Christ are for you Gentiles, too. And this is the secret: Christ lives in you. This gives you assurance of sharing his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: to whom God willed to make known what the wealth of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles is, the mystery that is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
verses.textEn: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

verses.textZh: 我们传扬他，是用诸般的智慧，劝戒各人，教导各人，要把各人在基督里完完全全地引到神面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们传扬他，是用诸般的智慧，劝戒各人，教导各人，要把各人在基督里完完全全地引到神面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们传扬他，是用诸般的智慧，劝戒各人，教导各人，要把各人在基督里完完全全地引到神面前。
verses.textEnNiv: He is the one we proclaim, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone fully mature in Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Him we proclaim, warning everyone and teaching everyone with all wisdom, that we may present everyone mature in Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Him we preach, warning every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: So we tell others about Christ, warning everyone and teaching everyone with all the wisdom God has given us. We want to present them to God, perfect in their relationship to Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: We proclaim Him, admonishing every person and teaching every person with all wisdom, so that we may present every person complete in Christ.
verses.textEn: He is the one we proclaim, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone fully mature in Christ.

verses.textZh: 我也为此劳苦，照着他在我里面运用的大能尽心竭力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也为此劳苦，照着他在我里面运用的大能尽心竭力。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也为此劳苦，照着他在我里面运用的大能尽心竭力。
verses.textEnNiv: To this end I strenuously contend with all the energy Christ so powerfully works in me.
verses.textEnEsv: For this I toil, struggling with all his energy that he powerfully works within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: To this end I also labor, striving according to His working which works in me mightily.
verses.textEnNlt: That’s why I work and struggle so hard, depending on Christ’s mighty power that works within me.
verses.textEnNasb: For this purpose I also labor, striving according to His power which works mightily within me.
verses.textEn: To this end I strenuously contend with all the energy Christ so powerfully works in me.

verses.textZh: 我愿意你们知道，我为你们和在老底嘉的人，以及所有没有跟我见过面的人，是怎样竭力奋斗，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我愿意你们知道，我为你们和在老底嘉的人，以及所有没有跟我见过面的人，是怎样竭力奋斗，
verses.textZhCuv: 我愿意你们晓得，我为你们和老底嘉人，并一切没有与我亲自见面的人，是何等地尽心竭力；
verses.textEnNiv: I want you to know how hard I am contending for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me personally.
verses.textEnEsv: For I want you to know how great a struggle I have for you and for those at Laodicea and for all who have not seen me face to face,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I want you to know what a great conflict I have for you and those in Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh,
verses.textEnNlt: I want you to know how much I have agonized for you and for the church at Laodicea, and for many other believers who have never met me personally.
verses.textEnNasb: For I want you to know how great a struggle I have in your behalf and for those who are at Laodicea, and for all those who have not personally seen my face,
verses.textEn: I want you to know how hard I am contending for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me personally.

verses.textZh: 为的是要他们的心得着勉励，在爱中彼此联系，可以得着凭悟性、因确信而来的一切丰盛，也可以充分认识神的奥秘，这奥秘就是基督；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为的是要他们的心得着勉励，在爱中彼此联系，可以得着凭悟性、因确信而来的一切丰盛，也可以充分认识神的奥秘，这奥秘就是基督；
verses.textZhCuv: 要叫他们的心得安慰，因爱心互相联络，以致丰丰足足在悟性中有充足的信心，使他们真知神的奥秘，就是基督；
verses.textEnNiv: My goal is that they may be encouraged in heart and united in love, so that they may have the full riches of complete understanding, in order that they may know the mystery of God, namely, Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: that their hearts may be encouraged, being knit together in love, to reach all the riches of full assurance of understanding and the knowledge of God’s mystery, which is Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: that their hearts may be encouraged, being knit together in love, and attaining to all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the knowledge of the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: I want them to be encouraged and knit together by strong ties of love. I want them to have complete confidence that they understand God’s mysterious plan, which is Christ himself.
verses.textEnNasb: that their hearts may be encouraged, having been knit together in love, and that they would attain to all the wealth that comes from the full assurance of understanding, resulting in a true knowledge of God’s mystery, that is, Christ Himself,
verses.textEn: My goal is that they may be encouraged in heart and united in love, so that they may have the full riches of complete understanding, in order that they may know the mystery of God, namely, Christ,

verses.textZh: 一切智慧和知识的宝库都蕴藏在基督里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切智慧和知识的宝库都蕴藏在基督里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 所积蓄的一切智慧知识，都在他里面藏着。
verses.textEnNiv: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: In him lie hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.textEnNasb: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.textEn: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.textZh: 我说这些话，免得有人用花言巧语欺骗你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说这些话，免得有人用花言巧语欺骗你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话，免得有人用花言巧语迷惑你们。
verses.textEnNiv: I tell you this so that no one may deceive you by fine-sounding arguments.
verses.textEnEsv: I say this in order that no one may delude you with plausible arguments.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this I say lest anyone should deceive you with persuasive words.
verses.textEnNlt: I am telling you this so no one will deceive you with well-crafted arguments.
verses.textEnNasb: I say this so that no one will deceive you with persuasive arguments.
verses.textEn: I tell you this so that no one may deceive you by fine-sounding arguments.

verses.textZh: 我虽然不在你们那里，心却与你们同在。我看见你们循规蹈矩，并且对基督有坚定的信心，就欢喜了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然不在你们那里，心却与你们同在。我看见你们循规蹈矩，并且对基督有坚定的信心，就欢喜了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我身子虽与你们相离，心却与你们同在，见你们循规蹈矩，信基督的心也坚固，我就欢喜了。
verses.textEnNiv: For though I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit and delight to see how disciplined you are and how firm your faith in Christ is.
verses.textEnEsv: For though I am absent in body, yet I am with you in spirit, rejoicing to see your good order and the firmness of your faith in Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in spirit, rejoicing to see your good order and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: For though I am far away from you, my heart is with you. And I rejoice that you are living as you should and that your faith in Christ is strong.
verses.textEnNasb: For even though I am absent in body, I am nevertheless with you in spirit, rejoicing to see your orderly manner and the stability of your faith in Christ.
verses.textEn: For though I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit and delight to see how disciplined you are and how firm your faith in Christ is.

verses.textZh: 你们怎样接受了基督耶稣为主，就当照样在他里面行事为人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们怎样接受了基督耶稣为主，就当照样在他里面行事为人，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既然接受了主基督耶稣，就当遵他而行，
verses.textEnNiv: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, as you received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk in him,
verses.textEnNkjv: As you therefore have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk in Him,
verses.textEnNlt: And now, just as you accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord, you must continue to follow him.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, as you have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk in Him,
verses.textEn: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him,

verses.textZh: 按着你们所领受的教导，在他里面扎根、建造，信心坚定，满有感谢的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着你们所领受的教导，在他里面扎根、建造，信心坚定，满有感谢的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他里面生根建造，信心坚固，正如你们所领的教训，感谢的心也更增长了。
verses.textEnNiv: rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
verses.textEnEsv: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding in thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNkjv: rooted and built up in Him and established in the faith, as you have been taught, abounding in it with thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNlt: Let your roots grow down into him, and let your lives be built on him. Then your faith will grow strong in the truth you were taught, and you will overflow with thankfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: having been firmly rooted and now being built up in Him and established in your faith, just as you were instructed, and overflowing with gratitude.
verses.textEn: rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

verses.textZh: 你们要谨慎，免得有人不照着基督，而照着人的传统，和世俗的言论，借着哲学和骗人的空谈，把你们掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要谨慎，免得有人不照着基督，而照着人的传统，和世俗的言论，借着哲学和骗人的空谈，把你们掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨慎，恐怕有人用他的理学和虚空的妄言，不照着基督，乃照人间的遗传和世上的小学就把你们掳去。
verses.textEnNiv: See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition and the elemental spiritual forces of this world rather than on Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: See to it that no one takes you captive by philosophy and empty deceit, according to human tradition, according to the elemental spirits of the world, and not according to Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Beware lest anyone cheat you through philosophy and empty deceit, according to the tradition of men, according to the basic principles of the world, and not according to Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let anyone capture you with empty philosophies and high-sounding nonsense that come from human thinking and from the spiritual powers of this world, rather than from Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: See to it that there is no one who takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception in accordance with human tradition, in accordance with the elementary principles of the world, rather than in accordance with Christ.
verses.textEn: See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition and the elemental spiritual forces of this world rather than on Christ.

verses.textZh: 因为神本性的一切丰盛，都有形有体地住在基督里面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神本性的一切丰盛，都有形有体地住在基督里面，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神本性一切的丰盛都有形有体地居住在基督里面，
verses.textEnNiv: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity lives in bodily form,
verses.textEnEsv: For in him the whole fullness of deity dwells bodily,
verses.textEnNkjv: For in Him dwells all the fullness of the Godhead bodily;
verses.textEnNlt: For in Christ lives all the fullness of God in a human body.
verses.textEnNasb: For in Him all the fullness of Deity dwells in bodily form,
verses.textEn: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity lives in bodily form,

verses.textZh: 你们也是在他里面得了丰盛。他是一切执政掌权者的元首。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也是在他里面得了丰盛。他是一切执政掌权者的元首。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在他里面也得了丰盛。他是各样执政掌权者的元首。
verses.textEnNiv: and in Christ you have been brought to fullness. He is the head over every power and authority.
verses.textEnEsv: and you have been filled in him, who is the head of all rule and authority.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you are complete in Him, who is the head of all principality and power.
verses.textEnNlt: So you also are complete through your union with Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
verses.textEnNasb: and in Him you have been made complete, and He is the head over every ruler and authority;
verses.textEn: and in Christ you have been brought to fullness. He is the head over every power and authority.

verses.textZh: 你们也在他里面受了不是由人手所行的割礼，而是受了基督的割礼，就是除掉你们的罪身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也在他里面受了不是由人手所行的割礼，而是受了基督的割礼，就是除掉你们的罪身。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在他里面也受了不是人手所行的割礼，乃是基督使你们脱去肉体情欲的割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not performed by human hands. Your whole self ruled by the flesh was put off when you were circumcised by Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: In him also you were circumcised with a circumcision made without hands, by putting off the body of the flesh, by the circumcision of Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: In Him you were also circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, by putting off the body of the sins of the flesh, by the circumcision of Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: When you came to Christ, you were "circumcised," but not by a physical procedure. Christ performed a spiritual circumcision—the cutting away of your sinful nature.
verses.textEnNasb: and in Him you were also circumcised with a circumcision performed without hands, in the removal of the body of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ,
verses.textEn: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not performed by human hands. Your whole self ruled by the flesh was put off when you were circumcised by Christ,

verses.textZh: 你们在洗礼中已经与他一同埋葬，也在洗礼中，因信那使基督从死人中复活的神所运行的动力，与他一同复活了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在洗礼中已经与他一同埋葬，也在洗礼中，因信那使基督从死人中复活的神所运行的动力，与他一同复活了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既受洗与他一同埋葬，也就在此与他一同复活，都因信那叫他从死里复活神的功用。
verses.textEnNiv: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through your faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the powerful working of God, who raised him from the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: buried with Him in baptism, in which you also were raised with Him through faith in the working of God, who raised Him from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: For you were buried with Christ when you were baptized. And with him you were raised to new life because you trusted the mighty power of God, who raised Christ from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: having been buried with Him in baptism, in which you were also raised with Him through faith in the working of God, who raised Him from the dead.
verses.textEn: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through your faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

verses.textZh: 你们因着过犯和肉体未受割礼，原是死的，然而神赦免了我们的一切过犯，使你们与基督一同活过来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们因着过犯和肉体未受割礼，原是死的，然而神赦免了我们的一切过犯，使你们与基督一同活过来，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从前在过犯和未受割礼的肉体中死了，神赦免了你们 一切过犯，便叫你们与基督一同活过来；
verses.textEnNiv: When you were dead in your sins and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our sins,
verses.textEnEsv: And you, who were dead in your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, being dead in your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, He has made alive together with Him, having forgiven you all trespasses,
verses.textEnNlt: You were dead because of your sins and because your sinful nature was not yet cut away. Then God made you alive with Christ, for he forgave all our sins.
verses.textEnNasb: And when you were dead in your wrongdoings and the uncircumcision of your flesh, He made you alive together with Him, having forgiven us all our wrongdoings,
verses.textEn: When you were dead in your sins and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our sins,

verses.textZh: 涂抹了那写在规条上反对我们、与我们为敌的字句，并且把这字句从我们中间拿去，钉在十字架上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 涂抹了那写在规条上反对我们、与我们为敌的字句，并且把这字句从我们中间拿去，钉在十字架上。
verses.textZhCuv: 又涂抹了在律例上所写、攻击我们、有碍于我们的字据，把它撤去，钉在十字架上。
verses.textEnNiv: having canceled the charge of our legal indebtedness, which stood against us and condemned us; he has taken it away, nailing it to the cross.
verses.textEnEsv: by canceling the record of debt that stood against us with its legal demands. This he set aside, nailing it to the cross.
verses.textEnNkjv: having wiped out the handwriting of requirements that was against us, which was contrary to us. And He has taken it out of the way, having nailed it to the cross.
verses.textEnNlt: He canceled the record of the charges against us and took it away by nailing it to the cross.
verses.textEnNasb: having canceled the certificate of debt consisting of decrees against us, which was hostile to us; and He has taken it out of the way, having nailed it to the cross.
verses.textEn: having canceled the charge of our legal indebtedness, which stood against us and condemned us; he has taken it away, nailing it to the cross.

verses.textZh: 他既然靠着十字架胜过了一切执政掌权的，废除了他们的权势，就在凯旋的行列中，把他们公开示众。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他既然靠着十字架胜过了一切执政掌权的，废除了他们的权势，就在凯旋的行列中，把他们公开示众。
verses.textZhCuv: 既将一切执政的、掌权的掳来，明显给众人看，就仗着十字架夸胜。
verses.textEnNiv: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.
verses.textEnEsv: He disarmed the rulers and authorities and put them to open shame, by triumphing over them in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Having disarmed principalities and powers, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them in it.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, he disarmed the spiritual rulers and authorities. He shamed them publicly by his victory over them on the cross.
verses.textEnNasb: When He had disarmed the rulers and authorities, He made a public display of them, having triumphed over them through Him.
verses.textEn: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.

verses.textZh: 所以不要让人因着饮食、节期、月朔、安息日批评你们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以不要让人因着饮食、节期、月朔、安息日批评你们，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，不拘在饮食上，或节期、月朔、安息日都不可让人论断你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore do not let anyone judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a religious festival, a New Moon celebration or a Sabbath day.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let no one pass judgment on you in questions of food and drink, or with regard to a festival or a new moon or a Sabbath.
verses.textEnNkjv: So let no one judge you in food or in drink, or regarding a festival or a new moon or sabbaths,
verses.textEnNlt: So don’t let anyone condemn you for what you eat or drink, or for not celebrating certain holy days or new moon ceremonies or Sabbaths.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, no one is to act as your judge in regard to food and drink, or in respect to a festival or a new moon, or a Sabbath day—
verses.textEn: Therefore do not let anyone judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a religious festival, a New Moon celebration or a Sabbath day.

verses.textZh: 这些不过是将来的事的影子，那真体却是属于基督的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些不过是将来的事的影子，那真体却是属于基督的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些原是后事的影儿；那形体却是基督。
verses.textEnNiv: These are a shadow of the things that were to come; the reality, however, is found in Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the substance belongs to Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: which are a shadow of things to come, but the substance is of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: For these rules are only shadows of the reality yet to come. And Christ himself is that reality.
verses.textEnNasb: things which are only a shadow of what is to come; but the substance belongs to Christ.
verses.textEn: These are a shadow of the things that were to come; the reality, however, is found in Christ.

verses.textZh: 不要让人夺去你们的奖赏，他们以故意谦卑，敬拜天使为乐；迷于自己所见过的；凭着肉体的意念，无故地自高自大；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要让人夺去你们的奖赏，他们以故意谦卑，敬拜天使为乐；迷于自己所见过的；凭着肉体的意念，无故地自高自大；
verses.textZhCuv: 不可让人因着故意谦虚和敬拜天使，就夺去你们的奖赏。这等人拘泥在所见过的 ，随着自己的欲心，无故地自高自大，
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you. Such a person also goes into great detail about what they have seen; they are puffed up with idle notions by their unspiritual mind.
verses.textEnEsv: Let no one disqualify you, insisting on asceticism and worship of angels, going on in detail about visions, puffed up without reason by his sensuous mind,
verses.textEnNkjv: Let no one cheat you of your reward, taking delight in false humility and worship of angels, intruding into those things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let anyone condemn you by insisting on pious self-denial or the worship of angels, saying they have had visions about these things. Their sinful minds have made them proud,
verses.textEnNasb: Take care that no one keeps defrauding you of your prize by delighting in humility and the worship of the angels, taking his stand on visions he has seen, inflated without cause by his fleshly mind,
verses.textEn: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you. Such a person also goes into great detail about what they have seen; they are puffed up with idle notions by their unspiritual mind.

verses.textZh: 不与头紧密相连。其实全身都是借着关节和筋络从头得着供应和联系，就照着神所要求的，生长起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不与头紧密相连。其实全身都是借着关节和筋络从头得着供应和联系，就照着神所要求的，生长起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 不持定元首。全身既然靠着他，筋节得以相助联络，就因神大得长进。
verses.textEnNiv: They have lost connection with the head, from whom the whole body, supported and held together by its ligaments and sinews, grows as God causes it to grow.
verses.textEnEsv: and not holding fast to the Head, from whom the whole body, nourished and knit together through its joints and ligaments, grows with a growth that is from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: and not holding fast to the Head, from whom all the body, nourished and knit together by joints and ligaments, grows with the increase thatis from God.
verses.textEnNlt: and they are not connected to Christ, the head of the body. For he holds the whole body together with its joints and ligaments, and it grows as God nourishes it.
verses.textEnNasb: and not holding firmly to the head, from whom the entire body, being supplied and held together by the joints and ligaments, grows with a growth which is from God.
verses.textEn: They have lost connection with the head, from whom the whole body, supported and held together by its ligaments and sinews, grows as God causes it to grow.

verses.textZh: 这些规条是照着人的命令和教训而定的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些规条是照着人的命令和教训而定的，
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是照人所吩咐、所教导的。说到这一切，正用的时候就都败坏了。
verses.textEnNiv: Since you died with Christ to the elemental spiritual forces of this world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its rules:
verses.textEnEsv: If with Christ you died to the elemental spirits of the world, why, as if you were still alive in the world, do you submit to regulations—
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, if you died with Christ from the basic principles of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to regulations—
verses.textEnNlt: You have died with Christ, and he has set you free from the spiritual powers of this world. So why do you keep on following the rules of the world, such as,
verses.textEnNasb: If you have died with Christ to the elementary principles of the world, why, as if you were living in the world, do you submit yourself to decrees, such as,
verses.textEn: Since you died with Christ to the elemental spiritual forces of this world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its rules:

verses.textZh: 在随着己意敬拜，故作谦卑，和苦待己身等事上，似乎是智慧之言，其实只能叫人放纵肉体，再没有任何价值。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在随着己意敬拜，故作谦卑，和苦待己身等事上，似乎是智慧之言，其实只能叫人放纵肉体，再没有任何价值。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些规条使人徒有智慧之名，用私意崇拜，自表谦卑，苦待己身，其实在克制肉体的情欲上是毫无功效。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not handle! Do not taste! Do not touch!"?
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not handle, Do not taste, Do not touch"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not touch, do not taste, do not handle,"
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t handle! Don’t taste! Don’t touch!"?
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!"
verses.textEn: "Do not handle! Do not taste! Do not touch!"?

verses.textZh: 这些规条所指的，都是一用就败坏的东西，不过是照着人的吩咐和教导罢了。
verses.textEnNiv: These rules, which have to do with things that are all destined to perish with use, are based on merely human commands and teachings.
verses.textEnEsv: ( referring to things that all perish as they are used)—according to human precepts and teachings?
verses.textEnNkjv: which all concern things which perish with the using— according to the commandments and doctrines of men?
verses.textEnNlt: Such rules are mere human teachings about things that deteriorate as we use them.
verses.textEnNasb: (which all refer to things destined to perish with use)—in accordance with the commandments and teachings of man?
verses.textEn: These rules, which have to do with things that are all destined to perish with use, are based on merely human commands and teachings.
verses.textZhCn: 这些规条所指的，都是一用就败坏的东西，不过是照着人的吩咐和教导罢了。

verses.textZh: 这些规条虽然表面上有智慧，是由私意敬拜、自表谦卑和苦待己身而来的，但对于克制肉体的情欲，是毫无价值的。
verses.textEnNiv: Such regulations indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-imposed worship, their false humility and their harsh treatment of the body, but they lack any value in restraining sensual indulgence.
verses.textEnEsv: These have indeed an appearance of wisdom in promoting self-made religion and asceticism and severity to the body, but they are of no value in stopping the indulgence of the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: These things indeed have an appearance of wisdom in self-imposed religion, false humility, and neglect of the body, butare of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: These rules may seem wise because they require strong devotion, pious self-denial, and severe bodily discipline. But they provide no help in conquering a person’s evil desires.
verses.textEnNasb: These are matters which do have the appearance of wisdom in self-made religion and humility and severe treatment of the body, but are of no value against fleshly indulgence.
verses.textEn: Such regulations indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-imposed worship, their false humility and their harsh treatment of the body, but they lack any value in restraining sensual indulgence.
verses.textZhCn: 这些规条虽然表面上有智慧，是由私意敬拜、自表谦卑和苦待己身而来的，但对于克制肉体的情欲，是毫无价值的。

verses.textZh: 所以，你们既然与基督一同复活，就应当寻求天上的事，那里有基督坐在神的右边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们既然与基督一同复活，就应当寻求天上的事，那里有基督坐在神的右边。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们若真与基督一同复活，就当求在上面的事；那里有基督坐在神的右边。
verses.textEnNiv: Since, then, you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.
verses.textEnEsv: If then you have been raised with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: If then you were raised with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ is, sitting at the right hand of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Since you have been raised to new life with Christ, set your sights on the realities of heaven, where Christ sits in the place of honor at God’s right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, if you have been raised with Christ, keep seeking the things that are above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.
verses.textEn: Since, then, you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God.

verses.textZh: 你们要思念的，是天上的事，不是地上的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要思念的，是天上的事，不是地上的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要思念上面的事，不要思念地上的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
verses.textEnEsv: Set your minds on things that are above, not on things that are on earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Set your mind on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Think about the things of heaven, not the things of earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Set your minds on the things that are above, not on the things that are on earth.
verses.textEn: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

verses.textZh: 因为你们已经死了，你们的生命与基督一同隐藏在神里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们已经死了，你们的生命与基督一同隐藏在神里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们已经死了，你们的生命与基督一同藏在神里面。
verses.textEnNiv: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
verses.textEnNlt: For you died to this life, and your real life is hidden with Christ in God.
verses.textEnNasb: For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
verses.textEn: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

verses.textZh: 基督就是你们的生命，他显现的时候，你们也要和他一同在荣耀里显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督就是你们的生命，他显现的时候，你们也要和他一同在荣耀里显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督是我们的生命，他显现的时候，你们也要与他一同显现在荣耀里。
verses.textEnNiv: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with him in glory.
verses.textEnEsv: When Christ who is your life appears, then you also will appear with him in glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Christ whois our life appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
verses.textEnNlt: And when Christ, who is your life, is revealed to the whole world, you will share in all his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: When Christ, who is our life, is revealed, then you also will be revealed with Him in glory.
verses.textEn: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with him in glory.

verses.textZh: 所以要治死你们在地上的肢体，就如淫乱、污秽、邪情、恶欲和贪心，贪心就是拜偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以要治死你们在地上的肢体，就如淫乱、污秽、邪情、恶欲和贪心，贪心就是拜偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，要治死你们在地上的肢体，就如淫乱、污秽、邪情、恶欲，和贪婪（贪婪就与拜偶像一样）。
verses.textEnNiv: Put to death, therefore, whatever belongs to your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires and greed, which is idolatry.
verses.textEnEsv: Put to death therefore what is earthly in you: sexual immorality, impurity, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore put to death your members which are on the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
verses.textEnNlt: So put to death the sinful, earthly things lurking within you. Have nothing to do with sexual immorality, impurity, lust, and evil desires. Don’t be greedy, for a greedy person is an idolater, worshiping the things of this world.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, treat the parts of your earthly body as dead to sexual immorality, impurity, passion, evil desire, and greed, which amounts to idolatry.
verses.textEn: Put to death, therefore, whatever belongs to your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires and greed, which is idolatry.

verses.textZh: 因着这些事，神的忿怒必要临到悖逆的人 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着这些事，神的忿怒必要临到悖逆的人 。
verses.textZhCuv: 因这些事，神的忿怒必临到那悖逆之子。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming.
verses.textEnEsv: On account of these the wrath of God is coming.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of these things the wrath of God is coming upon the sons of disobedience,
verses.textEnNlt: Because of these sins, the anger of God is coming.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is because of these things that the wrath of God is coming upon the sons of disobedience,
verses.textEn: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming.

verses.textZh: 你们从前在其中生活的时候，也曾经这样行过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们从前在其中生活的时候，也曾经这样行过。
verses.textZhCuv: 当你们在这些事中活着的时候，也曾这样行过。
verses.textEnNiv: You used to walk in these ways, in the life you once lived.
verses.textEnEsv: In these you too once walked, when you were living in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: in which you yourselves once walked when you lived in them.
verses.textEnNlt: You used to do these things when your life was still part of this world.
verses.textEnNasb: and in them you also once walked, when you were living in them.
verses.textEn: You used to walk in these ways, in the life you once lived.

verses.textZh: 但现在你们要除去忿怒、恼怒、恶毒、毁谤，以及粗言秽语这一切事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在你们要除去忿怒、恼怒、恶毒、毁谤，以及粗言秽语这一切事。
verses.textZhCuv: 但现在你们要弃绝这一切的事，以及恼恨、忿怒、恶毒 、毁谤，并口中污秽的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: But now you must also rid yourselves of all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
verses.textEnEsv: But now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and obscene talk from your mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now you yourselves are to put off all these: anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy language out of your mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: But now is the time to get rid of anger, rage, malicious behavior, slander, and dirty language.
verses.textEnNasb: But now you also, rid yourselves of all of them: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and obscene speech from your mouth.
verses.textEn: But now you must also rid yourselves of all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.

verses.textZh: 不要彼此说谎，因为你们已经脱去了旧人和旧人的行为，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要彼此说谎，因为你们已经脱去了旧人和旧人的行为，
verses.textZhCuv: 不要彼此说谎；因你们已经脱去旧人和旧人的行为，
verses.textEnNiv: Do not lie to each other, since you have taken off your old self with its practices
verses.textEnEsv: Do not lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old self with its practices
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not lie to one another, since you have put off the old man with his deeds,
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t lie to each other, for you have stripped off your old sinful nature and all its wicked deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not lie to one another, since you stripped off the old self with its evil practices,
verses.textEn: Do not lie to each other, since you have taken off your old self with its practices

verses.textZh: 穿上了新人。这新人照着他的创造者的形象渐渐更新，能够充分认识主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 穿上了新人。这新人照着他的创造者的形象渐渐更新，能够充分认识主。
verses.textZhCuv: 穿上了新人。这新人在知识上渐渐更新，正如造他主的形象。
verses.textEnNiv: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
verses.textEnEsv: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge after the image of its creator.
verses.textEnNkjv: and have put on the new man who is renewed in knowledge according to the image of Him who created him,
verses.textEnNlt: Put on your new nature, and be renewed as you learn to know your Creator and become like him.
verses.textEnNasb: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed to a true knowledge according to the image of the One who created it—
verses.textEn: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.

verses.textZh: 在这一方面，并不分希腊人和犹太人，受割礼的和未受割礼的，未开化的人和西古提人，奴隶和自由人，唯有基督是一切，也在一切之内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一方面，并不分希腊人和犹太人，受割礼的和未受割礼的，未开化的人和西古提人，奴隶和自由人，唯有基督是一切，也在一切之内。
verses.textZhCuv: 在此并不分希腊人、犹太人，受割礼的、未受割礼的，化外人、西古提人，为奴的、自主的，惟有基督是包括一切，又住在各人之内。
verses.textEnNiv: Here there is no Gentile or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave or free, but Christ is all, and is in all.
verses.textEnEsv: Here there is not Greek and Jew, circumcised and uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, free; but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcised nor uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave nor free, but Christ is all and in all.
verses.textEnNlt: In this new life, it doesn’t matter if you are a Jew or a Gentile, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbaric, uncivilized, slave, or free. Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
verses.textEnNasb: a renewal in which there is no distinction between Greek and Jew, circumcised and uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, and free, but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.textEn: Here there is no Gentile or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave or free, but Christ is all, and is in all.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们既然是神所拣选的，是圣洁、蒙爱的人，就要存怜悯的心肠、恩慈、谦卑、温柔和忍耐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们既然是神所拣选的，是圣洁、蒙爱的人，就要存怜悯的心肠、恩慈、谦卑、温柔和忍耐。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们既是神的选民，圣洁蒙爱的人，就要存 怜悯、恩慈、谦虚、温柔、忍耐的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, as God’s chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.
verses.textEnEsv: Put on then, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, and patience,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, put on tender mercies, kindness, humility, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.textEnNlt: Since God chose you to be the holy people he loves, you must clothe yourselves with tenderhearted mercy, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
verses.textEnNasb: So, as those who have been chosen of God, holy and beloved, put on a heart of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience;
verses.textEn: Therefore, as God’s chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.

verses.textZh: 如果有人对别人有嫌隙，总要彼此宽容，互相饶恕；主怎样饶恕了你们，你们也要照样饶恕人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人对别人有嫌隙，总要彼此宽容，互相饶恕；主怎样饶恕了你们，你们也要照样饶恕人。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若这人与那人有嫌隙，总要彼此包容，彼此饶恕；主怎样饶恕了你们，你们也要怎样饶恕人。
verses.textEnNiv: Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
verses.textEnEsv: bearing with one another and, if one has a complaint against another, forgiving each other; as the Lord has forgiven you, so you also must forgive.
verses.textEnNkjv: bearing with one another, and forgiving one another, if anyone has a complaint against another; even as Christ forgave you, so you also mustdo.
verses.textEnNlt: Make allowance for each other’s faults, and forgive anyone who offends you. Remember, the Lord forgave you, so you must forgive others.
verses.textEnNasb: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, whoever has a complaint against anyone; just as the Lord forgave you, so must you do also.
verses.textEn: Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

verses.textZh: 在这一切之上，还要有爱心，爱心是联系全德的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这一切之上，还要有爱心，爱心是联系全德的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这一切之外，要存着爱心，爱心就是联络全德的。
verses.textEnNiv: And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.
verses.textEnEsv: And above all these put on love, which binds everything together in perfect harmony.
verses.textEnNkjv: But above all these things put on love, which is the bond of perfection.
verses.textEnNlt: Above all, clothe yourselves with love, which binds us all together in perfect harmony.
verses.textEnNasb: In addition to all these things put on love, which is the perfect bond of unity.
verses.textEn: And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.

verses.textZh: 又要让基督的平安在你们心里作主；你们蒙召归为一体，也是为了这个缘故。你们要有感谢的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要让基督的平安在你们心里作主；你们蒙召归为一体，也是为了这个缘故。你们要有感谢的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要叫基督的平安在你们心里作主；你们也为此蒙召，归为一体；且要存感谢的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.
verses.textEnEsv: And let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, to which indeed you were called in one body. And be thankful.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
verses.textEnNlt: And let the peace that comes from Christ rule in your hearts. For as members of one body you are called to live in peace. And always be thankful.
verses.textEnNasb: Let the peace of Christ, to which you were indeed called in one body, rule in your hearts; and be thankful.
verses.textEn: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.

verses.textZh: 你们要让基督的道丰丰富富地住在你们心里，以各样的智慧，彼此教导，互相劝戒，用诗章、圣诗、灵歌，怀着感恩的心歌颂神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要让基督的道丰丰富富地住在你们心里，以各样的智慧，彼此教导，互相劝戒，用诗章、圣诗、灵歌，怀着感恩的心歌颂神。
verses.textZhCuv: 当用各样的智慧，把基督的道理丰丰富富地存在心里 ，用诗章、颂词、灵歌，彼此教导，互相劝戒，心被恩感，歌颂神。
verses.textEnNiv: Let the message of Christ dwell among you richly as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom through psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit, singing to God with gratitude in your hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom, singing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, with thankfulness in your hearts to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Let the message about Christ, in all its richness, fill your lives. Teach and counsel each other with all the wisdom he gives. Sing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs to God with thankful hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you, with all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with thankfulness in your hearts to God.
verses.textEn: Let the message of Christ dwell among you richly as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom through psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit, singing to God with gratitude in your hearts.

verses.textZh: 凡你们所作的，无论是言语或行为，都要奉主耶稣的名，借着他感谢父神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡你们所作的，无论是言语或行为，都要奉主耶稣的名，借着他感谢父神。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论做什么，或说话或行事，都要奉主耶稣的名，藉着他感谢父神。
verses.textEnNiv: And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
verses.textEnEsv: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever you do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And whatever you do or say, do it as a representative of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks through him to God the Father.
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever you do in word or deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks through Him to God the Father.
verses.textEn: And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

verses.textZh: 你们作妻子的，要顺服丈夫，这在主里是合宜的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作妻子的，要顺服丈夫，这在主里是合宜的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作妻子的，当顺服自己的丈夫，这在主里面是相宜的。
verses.textEnNiv: Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wives, submit to your own husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting for those who belong to the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Wives, be subject to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
verses.textEn: Wives, submit yourselves to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 你们作丈夫的，要爱妻子，不可苦待她们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作丈夫的，要爱妻子，不可苦待她们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，不可苦待她们。
verses.textEnNiv: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
verses.textEnEsv: Husbands, love your wives, and do not be harsh with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Husbands, love your wives and do not be bitter toward them.
verses.textEnNlt: Husbands, love your wives and never treat them harshly.
verses.textEnNasb: Husbands, love your wives and do not become bitter against them.
verses.textEn: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

verses.textZh: 你们作儿女的，要凡事听从父母，因为这在主里是可喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作儿女的，要凡事听从父母，因为这在主里是可喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作儿女的，要凡事听从父母，因为这是主所喜悦的。
verses.textEnNiv: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this is well pleasing to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Children, always obey your parents, for this pleases the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.

verses.textZh: 你们作父亲的，不要激怒儿女，免得他们灰心丧志。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作父亲的，不要激怒儿女，免得他们灰心丧志。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，恐怕他们失了志气。
verses.textEnNiv: Fathers, do not embitter your children, or they will become discouraged.
verses.textEnEsv: Fathers, do not provoke your children, lest they become discouraged.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fathers, do not provoke your children, lest they become discouraged.
verses.textEnNlt: Fathers, do not aggravate your children, or they will become discouraged.
verses.textEnNasb: Fathers, do not antagonize your children, so that they will not become discouraged.
verses.textEn: Fathers, do not embitter your children, or they will become discouraged.

verses.textZh: 你们作仆人的，要凡事听从世上的主人，作事不要只作给人看，像那些讨人欢心的一样，却要以真诚的心敬畏主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作仆人的，要凡事听从世上的主人，作事不要只作给人看，像那些讨人欢心的一样，却要以真诚的心敬畏主。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作仆人的，要凡事听从你们肉身的主人，不要只在眼前事奉，像是讨人喜欢的，总要存心诚实敬畏主。
verses.textEnNiv: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything; and do it, not only when their eye is on you and to curry their favor, but with sincerity of heart and reverence for the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Bondservants, obey in everything those who are your earthly masters, not by way of eye-service, as people-pleasers, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bondservants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh, not with eyeservice, as men-pleasers, but in sincerity of heart, fearing God.
verses.textEnNlt: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything you do. Try to please them all the time, not just when they are watching you. Serve them sincerely because of your reverent fear of the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Slaves, obey those who are your human masters in everything, not with eye-service, as people-pleasers, but with sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.
verses.textEn: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything; and do it, not only when their eye is on you and to curry their favor, but with sincerity of heart and reverence for the Lord.

verses.textZh: 无论你们作甚么，都要从心里去作，像是为主作的，不是为人作的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论你们作甚么，都要从心里去作，像是为主作的，不是为人作的，
verses.textZhCuv: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的，
verses.textEnNiv: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters,
verses.textEnEsv: Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
verses.textEnNkjv: And whatever you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord and not to men,
verses.textEnNlt: Work willingly at whatever you do, as though you were working for the Lord rather than for people.
verses.textEnNasb: Whatever you do, do your work heartily, as for the Lord and not for people,
verses.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters,

verses.textZh: 因为你们知道，你们一定会从主那里得到基业为赏赐。你们应当服事主基督，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们知道，你们一定会从主那里得到基业为赏赐。你们应当服事主基督，
verses.textZhCuv: 因你们知道从主那里必得着基业为赏赐；你们所事奉的乃是主基督。
verses.textEnNiv: since you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
verses.textEnEsv: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the inheritance as your reward. You are serving the Lord Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that the Lord will give you an inheritance as your reward, and that the Master you are serving is Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing that it is from the Lord that you will receive the reward of the inheritance. It is the Lord Christ whom you serve.
verses.textEn: since you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

verses.textZh: 但那些不义的人，必按他所行的不义受报应。主并不偏待人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那些不义的人，必按他所行的不义受报应。主并不偏待人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那行不义的必受不义的报应；主并不偏待人。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who does wrong will be repaid for their wrongs, and there is no favoritism.
verses.textEnEsv: For the wrongdoer will be paid back for the wrong he has done, and there is no partiality.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who does wrong will be repaid for what he has done, and there is no partiality.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you do what is wrong, you will be paid back for the wrong you have done. For God has no favorites.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one who does wrong will receive the consequences of the wrong which he has done, and that without partiality.
verses.textEn: Anyone who does wrong will be repaid for their wrongs, and there is no favoritism.

verses.textZh: 你们作主人的，要公平地对待仆人，因为知道你们也有一位主在天上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作主人的，要公平地对待仆人，因为知道你们也有一位主在天上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作主人的，要公公平平地待仆人，因为知道你们也有一位主在天上。
verses.textEnNiv: Masters, provide your slaves with what is right and fair, because you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: Masters, treat your bondservants justly and fairly, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Masters, give your bondservants what is just and fair, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: Masters, be just and fair to your slaves. Remember that you also have a Master—in heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Masters, grant your slaves justice and fairness, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
verses.textEn: Masters, provide your slaves with what is right and fair, because you know that you also have a Master in heaven.

verses.textZh: 你们要恒切祷告，在祷告的时候存着感恩的心警醒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要恒切祷告，在祷告的时候存着感恩的心警醒；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要恒切祷告，在此警醒感恩。
verses.textEnNiv: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful.
verses.textEnEsv: Continue steadfastly in prayer, being watchful in it with thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNkjv: Continue earnestly in prayer, being vigilant in it with thanksgiving;
verses.textEnNlt: Devote yourselves to prayer with an alert mind and a thankful heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Devote yourselves to prayer, keeping alert in it with an attitude of thanksgiving;
verses.textEn: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful.

verses.textZh: 也要为我们祷告，求神为我们开传道的门，宣讲基督的奥秘 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要为我们祷告，求神为我们开传道的门，宣讲基督的奥秘 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 也要为我们祷告，求神给我们开传道的门，能以讲基督的奥秘（我为此被捆锁），
verses.textEnNiv: And pray for us, too, that God may open a door for our message, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.
verses.textEnEsv: At the same time, pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, to declare the mystery of Christ, on account of which I am in prison—
verses.textEnNkjv: meanwhile praying also for us, that God would open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in chains,
verses.textEnNlt: Pray for us, too, that God will give us many opportunities to speak about his mysterious plan concerning Christ. That is why I am here in chains.
verses.textEnNasb: praying at the same time for us as well, that God will open up to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I have also been imprisoned;
verses.textEn: And pray for us, too, that God may open a door for our message, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.

verses.textZh: 使我照着我所应当说的，把这奥秘显明出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我照着我所应当说的，把这奥秘显明出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫我按着所该说的话将这奥秘发明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Pray that I may proclaim it clearly, as I should.
verses.textEnEsv: that I may make it clear, which is how I ought to speak.
verses.textEnNkjv: that I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.textEnNlt: Pray that I will proclaim this message as clearly as I should.
verses.textEnNasb: that I may make it clear in the way that I ought to proclaim it.
verses.textEn: Pray that I may proclaim it clearly, as I should.

verses.textZh: 你们要把握时机，用智慧与外人来往。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把握时机，用智慧与外人来往。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要爱惜光阴，用智慧与外人交往。
verses.textEnNiv: Be wise in the way you act toward outsiders; make the most of every opportunity.
verses.textEnEsv: Walk in wisdom toward outsiders, making the best use of the time.
verses.textEnNkjv: Walk in wisdom toward those whoare outside, redeeming the time.
verses.textEnNlt: Live wisely among those who are not believers, and make the most of every opportunity.
verses.textEnNasb: Conduct yourselves with wisdom toward outsiders, making the most of the opportunity.
verses.textEn: Be wise in the way you act toward outsiders; make the most of every opportunity.

verses.textZh: 你们的话要常常温和，好象是用盐调和的，使你们知道应当怎样回答各人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的话要常常温和，好象是用盐调和的，使你们知道应当怎样回答各人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的言语要常常带着和气，好像用盐调和，就可知道该怎样回答各人。
verses.textEnNiv: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how you ought to answer each person.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
verses.textEnNlt: Let your conversation be gracious and attractive so that you will have the right response for everyone.
