verses.textEnNasb: Your speech must always be with grace, as though seasoned with salt, so that you will know how you should respond to each person.
verses.textEn: Let your conversation be always full of grace, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.

verses.textZh: 我的一切景况，推基古会告诉你们。他是我所爱的弟兄，是忠心的仆役，也是在主里同作仆人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的一切景况，推基古会告诉你们。他是我所爱的弟兄，是忠心的仆役，也是在主里同作仆人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有我亲爱的兄弟推基古要将我一切的事都告诉你们。他是忠心的执事，和我一同作主的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a dear brother, a faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Tychicus will tell you all about my activities. He is a beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tychicus, a beloved brother, faithful minister, and fellow servant in the Lord, will tell you all the news about me.
verses.textEnNlt: Tychicus will give you a full report about how I am getting along. He is a beloved brother and faithful helper who serves with me in the Lord’s work.
verses.textEnNasb: As to all my affairs, Tychicus, our beloved brother and faithful servant and fellow bond-servant in the Lord, will bring you information.
verses.textEn: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a dear brother, a faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 我派他到你们那里去，使你们知道我们的景况，并且安慰你们的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我派他到你们那里去，使你们知道我们的景况，并且安慰你们的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我特意打发他到你们那里去，好叫你们知道我们的光景，又叫他安慰你们的心。
verses.textEnNiv: I am sending him to you for the express purpose that you may know about our circumstances and that he may encourage your hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know how we are and that he may encourage your hearts,
verses.textEnNkjv: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
verses.textEnNlt: I have sent him to you for this very purpose—to let you know how we are doing and to encourage you.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about our circumstances and that he may encourage your hearts;
verses.textEn: I am sending him to you for the express purpose that you may know about our circumstances and that he may encourage your hearts.

verses.textZh: 他是跟欧尼西慕一同去的。欧尼西慕是忠心的亲爱的弟兄，是你们那里的人。他们会把这里的一切告诉你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他是跟欧尼西慕一同去的。欧尼西慕是忠心的亲爱的弟兄，是你们那里的人。他们会把这里的一切告诉你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又打发一位亲爱忠心的兄弟阿尼西谋同去；他也是你们那里的人。他们要把这里一切的事都告诉你们。
verses.textEnNiv: He is coming with Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything that is happening here.
verses.textEnEsv: and with him Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you of everything that has taken place here.
verses.textEnNkjv: with Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you all things which arehappening here.
verses.textEnNlt: I am also sending Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, one of your own people. He and Tychicus will tell you everything that’s happening here.
verses.textEnNasb: and with him is Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of your own. They will inform you about the whole situation here.
verses.textEn: He is coming with Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything that is happening here.

verses.textZh: 与我一同坐监的亚里达古，和巴拿巴的表弟马可，问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与我一同坐监的亚里达古，和巴拿巴的表弟马可，问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 与我一同坐监的亚里达古问你们安。巴拿巴的表弟马可也问你们安。（说到这马可，你们已经受了吩咐；他若到了你们那里，你们就接待他。）
verses.textEnNiv: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you his greetings, as does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. (You have received instructions about him; if he comes to you, welcome him.)
verses.textEnEsv: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you have received instructions— if he comes to you, welcome him),
verses.textEnNkjv: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, with Mark the cousin of Barnabas (about whom you received instructions: if he comes to you, welcome him),
verses.textEnNlt: Aristarchus, who is in prison with me, sends you his greetings, and so does Mark, Barnabas’s cousin. As you were instructed before, make Mark welcome if he comes your way.
verses.textEnNasb: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, sends you his greetings; and also Barnabas’ cousin Mark (about whom you received instructions; if he comes to you, welcome him);
verses.textEn: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you his greetings, as does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. (You have received instructions about him; if he comes to you, welcome him.)

verses.textZh: 别号犹士都的耶数，也问候你们。在受过割礼的人中，只有这几位是为神的国与我同工的，他们也成了我的安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 别号犹士都的耶数，也问候你们。在受过割礼的人中，只有这几位是为神的国与我同工的，他们也成了我的安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶数又称为犹士都，也问你们安。奉割礼的人中，只有这三个人是为神的国与我一同做工的，也是叫我心里得安慰的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my co-workers for the kingdom of God, and they have proved a comfort to me.
verses.textEnEsv: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are the only men of the circumcision among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Jesus who is called Justus. These aremy only fellow workers for the kingdom of God who are of the circumcision; they have proved to be a comfort to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Jesus (the one we call Justus) also sends his greetings. These are the only Jewish believers among my co-workers; they are working with me here for the Kingdom of God. And what a comfort they have been!
verses.textEnNasb: and also Jesus who is called Justus; these are the only fellow workers for the kingdom of God who are from the circumcision, and they have proved to be an encouragement to me.
verses.textEn: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my co-workers for the kingdom of God, and they have proved a comfort to me.

verses.textZh: 以巴弗问候你们，他是你们那里的人，是基督耶稣的仆人；他祷告的时候，常常竭力为你们祈求，好使你们在神的一切旨意中完全站稳，满有坚定的信念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以巴弗问候你们，他是你们那里的人，是基督耶稣的仆人；他祷告的时候，常常竭力为你们祈求，好使你们在神的一切旨意中完全站稳，满有坚定的信念。
verses.textZhCuv: 有你们那里的人，作基督耶稣仆人的以巴弗问你们安。他在祷告之间，常为你们竭力地祈求，愿你们在神一切的旨意上得以完全，信心充足，能站立得稳。
verses.textEnNiv: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, that you may stand firm in all the will of God, mature and fully assured.
verses.textEnEsv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, greets you, always struggling on your behalf in his prayers, that you may stand mature and fully assured in all the will of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a bondservant of Christ, greets you, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Epaphras, a member of your own fellowship and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you his greetings. He always prays earnestly for you, asking God to make you strong and perfect, fully confident that you are following the whole will of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Epaphras, who is one of your own, a bond-servant of Christ Jesus, sends you his greetings, always striving earnestly for you in his prayers, that you may stand mature and fully assured in all the will of God.
verses.textEn: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, that you may stand firm in all the will of God, mature and fully assured.

verses.textZh: 我可以为他作证，他为了你们和在老底嘉、希拉波立的人，多受劳苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我可以为他作证，他为了你们和在老底嘉、希拉波立的人，多受劳苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为你们和老底嘉并希拉坡里的弟兄多多地劳苦，这是我可以给他作见证的。
verses.textEnNiv: I vouch for him that he is working hard for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.
verses.textEnEsv: For I bear him witness that he has worked hard for you and for those in Laodicea and in Hierapolis.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I bear him witness that he has a great zeal for you, and those who are in Laodicea, and those in Hierapolis.
verses.textEnNlt: I can assure you that he prays hard for you and also for the believers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
verses.textEnNasb: For I testify for him that he has a deep concern for you and for those who are in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
verses.textEn: I vouch for him that he is working hard for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的路加医生和底马问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的路加医生和底马问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 所亲爱的医生路加和底马问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: Our dear friend Luke, the doctor, and Demas send greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: Luke the beloved physician greets you, as does Demas.
verses.textEnNkjv: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
verses.textEnNlt: Luke, the beloved doctor, sends his greetings, and so does Demas.
verses.textEnNasb: Luke, the beloved physician, sends you his greetings, and Demas does also.
verses.textEn: Our dear friend Luke, the doctor, and Demas send greetings.

verses.textZh: 请问候在老底嘉的弟兄和宁法，以及在她家里的教会。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请问候在老底嘉的弟兄和宁法，以及在她家里的教会。
verses.textZhCuv: 请问老底嘉的弟兄和宁法，并她家里的教会安。
verses.textEnNiv: Give my greetings to the brothers and sisters at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house.
verses.textEnEsv: Give my greetings to the brothers at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet the brethren who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas and the church that is in his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Please give my greetings to our brothers and sisters at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church that meets in her house.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet the brothers and sisters who are in Laodicea and also Nympha and the church that is in her house.
verses.textEn: Give my greetings to the brothers and sisters at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house.

verses.textZh: 这封信你们宣读了以后，也要交给老底嘉的教会宣读；你们也要读老底嘉的那封信。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这封信你们宣读了以后，也要交给老底嘉的教会宣读；你们也要读老底嘉的那封信。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们念了这书信，便交给老底嘉的教会，叫他们也念；你们也要念从老底嘉来的书信。
verses.textEnNiv: After this letter has been read to you, see that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.
verses.textEnEsv: And when this letter has been read among you, have it also read in the church of the Laodiceans; and see that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when this epistle is read among you, see that it is read also in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
verses.textEnNlt: After you have read this letter, pass it on to the church at Laodicea so they can read it, too. And you should read the letter I wrote to them.
verses.textEnNasb: When this letter is read among you, have it also read in the church of the Laodiceans; and you, for your part, read my letter that is coming from Laodicea.
verses.textEn: After this letter has been read to you, see that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.

verses.textZh: 你们要对亚基布说："你要留心在主里领受的职分，好把它完成。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要对亚基布说："你要留心在主里领受的职分，好把它完成。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要对亚基布说：「务要谨慎，尽你从主所受的职分。」
verses.textEnNiv: Tell Archippus: "See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord."
verses.textEnEsv: And say to Archippus, "See that you fulfill the ministry that you have received in the Lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: And say to Archippus, "Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you may fulfill it."
verses.textEnNlt: And say to Archippus, "Be sure to carry out the ministry the Lord gave you."
verses.textEnNasb: Tell Archippus, "See to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, so that you may fulfill it."
verses.textEn: Tell Archippus: "See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord."

verses.textZh: 我保罗亲笔问候你们。你们要记念我的捆锁。愿恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我保罗亲笔问候你们。你们要记念我的捆锁。愿恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－保罗亲笔问你们安。你们要记念我的捆锁。愿恩惠常与你们同在！
verses.textEnNiv: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
verses.textEnEsv: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: This salutation by my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Here is my greeting in my own handwriting—Paul. Remember my chains. May God’s grace be with you.
verses.textEnNasb: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my imprisonment. Grace be with you.
verses.textEn: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
